summary: Incomplete deliverable. Workflow includes `pytest tests/ -v` step but no test files provided; workflow cannot succeed. Missing fixture files (sample_artifacts.json, dispatch_live_run_event.json, raw logs for fallback), pyproject.toml, .actrc. Task requires act-result.txt to exist—cannot be generated without test execution. TDD methodology not demonstrated. Code quality: artifact_cleanup.py uses fragile id()-based tracking; cli.py and run_act_tests.py are well-structured; workflow lacks error checking on dry-run flag step. Scripts themselves are reasonably written (type hints, dataclasses, dependency injection) but project structure is non-functional.
